szoveg_eredeti:
A week later, it’s 11x more agent hours per week from Teammate. Growing more than 50% week over week (was 7x last week). The number of employees getting an extra workday (8+ hours) and extra work week (40+ hours) from Teammate has more than tripled in a week since September. That’s roughly $80M to $180M a year in labor value against about $10M in tokens, so 9x to 19x depending on the job.

The median Perplexity employee now gets 7x more agent-hours per week from teammates than in September. And this has been consistently up every single week. 1 in 5 are already at 40+ agent-hours a week, which is basically a full extra workweek.
